key_risks: Loan-to-value of 82.1% exceeds the policy limit of 75% (R1).
Debt service coverage ratio of 1.15x is below the required minimum of 1.25x (R2).
Personal guarantee is absent despite the loan amount exceeding £1,000,000 (R4).
Net debt to EBITDA of 4.6x breaches the maximum allowed ratio of 3.5x (R6).
Financial covenant of a minimum DSCR 1.20x is weaker than the policy threshold of 1.25x (R7).
mitigants: Borrower has 4 years of trading history, exceeding the minimum 2‑year requirement.
Audited financial statements have been provided, giving a reliable view of performance.
The loan tenor of 8 years is within the policy maximum of 10 years.
The hospitality boutique‑hotel sector is not on the excluded list.
Security is a first legal charge over the acquired hotel property, providing primary recourse.
risk.summary: The proposal fails multiple high‑severity policy tests, notably LTV (82.1% > 75%), DSCR (1.15x < 1.25x), lack of a personal guarantee, net debt/EBITDA (4.6x > 3.5x) and a covenant weaker than required. While the borrower shows a solid trading track record, audited accounts, acceptable tenor and primary security over the hotel, these mitigants do not offset the significant breaches. Consequently the overall risk is assessed as High and the recommendation is to decline the loan.
